## Scope and ownership boundary

Describe exactly what changed, and which kernel/UMI/service boundary owns it.

## Governing design

Link the relevant ADR and architecture documents; add an ADR if changing a ratified boundary.

## Validation

Commands, toolchain, host/guest, observed results, negative tests, failed/partial runs, and limitations.

## Security review

Caller identity, default deny, capability/revocation behavior, malformed messages, timeouts and bounded resource use, if applicable.

## Change authorization

Confirm the project owner explicitly authorized the relevant GitHub operations. A PR description is not itself authorization to merge.
